findings.title: Checkout recovery clears the allergy note and submits an order without it
findings.expected: Preserve the exact store request through a missing-address error and cart/back recovery, and show it in the final order.
findings.observed: The note remains intact after both coupon attempts, then changes from 28/50 to 0/50 after submitting without a detail address. Completing with 302동1104호 displays 가게 요청: 없음. Re-entering the note and returning through the cart also clears it; address, coupon, delivery request and payment remain intact.
steps: At 384x832, choose 반반치킨 (후라이드+양념), 순살 and 콜라 1.25L; try add without sauce, select 매운 양념 and add.
Increase cart quantity to 2 and open checkout.
Enter 땅콩 알레르기가 있어요. 양념에 땅콩가루 빼 주세요 and choose 문 앞에 두고 벨 눌러주세요.
Apply HANKI5000, then HANKKI5000; select 동네페이.
Submit with detail address blank; inspect the emptied note.
Enter 302동1104호 and submit; inspect 가게 요청: 없음 and the otherwise correct 48,000원 order.
Separate recovery replay: re-enter the note, return to cart and reopen checkout; observe 0/50 again.
limits: Observed form-state loss and final displayed omission; backend persistence and fulfilment are untested.
The trigger is verified by before/after input values. An internal rerender/default-state explanation is a hypothesis because source was not read.
No real food or payment was involved. Safety consequences beyond the fake fixture are inferred.

cause_chain.observed: Validation/back transitions empty the request field; the final order omits the entered instruction.
cause_chain.inferred: A user who does not notice the reset may submit an incomplete allergy instruction.

findings.recommendation: Preserve the store-request value through validation and navigation. Replay both triggers and compare the final note character for character.

second_pass.omitted: The entered allergy note is cleared after failed address submission and is absent from the final order.

findings.title: Required portion choices cannot be operated by keyboard
findings.expected: Reach and choose 순살 using keyboard navigation, then continue the requested order.
findings.observed: A fresh-page Tab/Enter run opens the item, but the option-screen Tab cycle reaches sauce, extras, add and back while skipping both portion choices. 순살 +2,000원 is a DIV with no role, tabIndex -1 and no checked state. Pointer selection works, but the keyboard task is blocked at this required choice.
steps: Open the fresh variant B page at 384x832.
Press Tab 13 times to the half-and-half menu button, then Enter.
Press Tab through a complete options cycle, including back and add.
Try to reach the required portion choice; it is absent from that cycle.
limits: Later variant B keyboard checkout steps were not executed after the block.
DOM semantics and actual Tab navigation were inspected; screen-reader and voice-control operation were not tested.
Formal KWCAG/WCAG conformity was not assessed.

cause_chain.observed: The visible portion choices are not focusable controls in the tested Tab sequence.
cause_chain.inferred: Keyboard-only users cannot obtain the requested boneless order.

findings.recommendation: Expose the portion choices as named, keyboard-operable single-selection controls and replay the full keyboard order.

second_pass.omitted: The required portion options never appear in the recorded Tab cycle.
second_pass.limits: The image establishes the visible portion control; the accompanying DOM and keyboard trace establish its inoperability. A screenshot alone cannot prove the keyboard behavior.

findings.title: Narrow layouts clip option surcharges and payment-summary amounts
findings.expected: Read the complete sauce name and surcharge, and the complete payment breakdown at 384x832 and 320x568.
findings.observed: At 384px, the sauce cards clip the end of 매운 양념 +500원 and 간장마늘 +1,000원. At 320px, more of both surcharges is hidden. At 320px the checkout summary also extends past the right edge, cutting digits and the currency unit from 50,000원, 3,000원, −5,000원 and 48,000원. The fixed payment button still shows 48,000원, and the desktop summary is readable.
steps: Open the half-and-half options in B at 384x832 and review the three sauce cards.
Resize to 320x568 and review the selected spicy-sauce card.
With quantity 2 and the valid coupon applied, scroll checkout to the bottom at 320x568.
Compare the clipped breakdown with the complete 1440x900 rendering.
limits: This finding follows inspected screenshots, not geometric intersections alone.
The total can still be read in the payment button; no incorrect charge was observed.
Horizontal-scroll recovery was not exercised. Figma fidelity and implementation cause are unknown.
findings.recommendation: Allow full sauce text and amounts to fit or wrap within each viewport; keep the payment breakdown inside the available width.

findings.title: Attempting to add without sauce provides no error explanation
findings.expected: Reject the incomplete item and identify the missing required sauce so the user can recover.
findings.observed: After choosing 순살 and 콜라 1.25L, pressing 24,500원 담기 leaves the options screen unchanged, with no inline sauce error or explanatory text. The item can be added after choosing 매운 양념, and the earlier choices remain selected.
steps: Open the half-and-half item at 384x832.
Choose 순살 and 콜라 1.25L while leaving sauce unselected.
Press 24,500원 담기 and inspect the screen and visible DOM text.
Choose 매운 양념; observe 25,000원 담기 and successfully add.
limits: The flow is recoverable when the missing option is known; the fixture did not accept an incomplete item.
This is missing feedback in the observed post-action state, not a measured abandonment rate.
findings.recommendation: Identify the missing sauce in a visible, associated error while retaining portion and extra selections.

findings.title: Cart quantity buttons have no accessible names
findings.expected: Distinguish the decrease and increase actions by accessible name, including the affected item.
findings.observed: The two visible minus/plus buttons appear as unnamed button entries in the accessibility snapshot. Their DOM has no text, aria-label, aria-labelledby or title. Pointer activation of the increase button correctly changes quantity to 2 and subtotal to 50,000원.
steps: Add the configured half-and-half item and open B cart.
Inspect the two quantity buttons and the accessibility tree.
Activate the visible plus control and confirm the arithmetic separately.
limits: The missing names are verified in DOM and accessibility output. Actual screen-reader speech and voice-control behavior are untested.
This issue is separate from the portion-control keyboard block; the quantity buttons are native focusable buttons.
findings.recommendation: Provide explicit decrease/increase names tied to the cart item.

limitations: Figma source unavailable; design fidelity is unknown. Findings concern reproduced reading, action and state failures.
Owned headless Chromium contexts, CSS viewport emulation and DPR 1 only. No real-device keyboard occlusion, grip, safe-area, Safari/WebKit, screen reader or voice-control testing.
No product HTML/JS/CSS source, other operator output, reports, keys, memory or prior sessions were read. Product was not modified.
Final rendered order values were checked. Backend records, actual payment, delivery fulfilment and production behavior remain unverified.
No formal KWCAG/WCAG conformity assessment; error association and accessible names were inspected only where reported.
200% text resizing, text-spacing overrides, contrast analysis, IME composition, reload persistence and every alternative payment option were not exercised.
Full keyboard coverage for B stops at its reproduced required-portion blocker.

Two locator assumptions failed during exploration and were corrected by inspecting visible controls. A missing helper in the first options cell interrupted capture after actions; the already-reached state was captured in the next call. No failed product state was converted into a pass.
